execution_assessment.alternative_without_hysys: CoolProp PR-EOS can compute single-phase and two-phase properties for pure components and simple mixtures. However, it CANNOT replicate the full Aspen HYSYS flowsheet (multi-stream heat exchanger rating, compressor characteristic map matching, recycle convergence, or coupled separator-MCHE-compressor loop). CoolProp-based DoE would be a REDUCED-FIDELITY SURROGATE, not a physical simulator replacement.
execution_assessment.blocker_if_no_hysys: Without HYSYS COM automation, Priority 7 (Physical DoE) and Priority 8 (True Joint Optimization) CANNOT produce genuine physical simulator results. The optimization must be reported as BLOCKED PENDING HYSYS RUNTIME.
